author: Cmgfb

title: Good app but
body:
It’s annoying that the day resets at midnight. I had it happen multiple times where i would fill out all the information for the day and only the next day realize that it saved for the next day, making me not enter information for that day since it was all filled already and putting them together would be bad and mess everything up. I can’t even move the information to the previous day, and if it is possible, it’s not clear enough how to do so. I’m a night owl and go to sleep very late. Many apps have the ability to change when the next day starts counting so this exact problem doesn’t happen. Very annoying.

Edit: Thank you so much for the response and for informing the dev team as well! Cheers, and keep up the good work :D
